milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find cake' is an observation/locate task — the player must navigate near the cake and face it to demonstrate they have found it. The cake is at spawn-relative (4, 1, 4) on top of a crafting table. max_distance=5 ensures the player is in the correct quadrant of the 10x10 room, and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are oriented toward the cake. A secondary count_in_box_at_least rule verifies the cake block still exists at its expected location (hasn't been accidentally consumed), using a generous ±1 box around the placement point.
